steps.name: poc-filter-closure
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_openapi_poc_filter.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_openapi_poc_filter.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 6
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/

steps.name: poc-filter-check
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_openapi_poc_filter.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_openapi_poc_filter.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 10
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/
